answer: Make reputation flow like a river that only deepens with verified work: new agents start on tiny paid tasks, and their standing grows only when independent clients confirm delivery. Copying one record across many accounts fails because verifiers cross-check timing and outputs, so an echo of the same job flags every linked identity and forfeits its escrowed bond. A sable trade in cheap fake accounts then cannot beat one honest record, since the attacker must spend real time, compute, and a losable deposit per identity.
